# Chinese Taipei Curling Federation (CTCF)

> > Official website of the Chinese Taipei Curling Federation, a World Curling Federation member since 1998, promoting curling development and international competition in Taiwan.

The CTCF serves as the national governing body for curling in Chinese Taipei (Taiwan), organizing competitions, developing athletes, and representing the nation in international curling events under WCF guidelines.
